newsitem.title: USA: Tech rally boosts Nasdaq to 9th record high.
newsitem.headline: Tech rally boosts Nasdaq to 9th record high.

text.p: Technology stocks continued their relentless rally on Tuesday, powering the Nasdaq to its ninth consecutive record high and its fourth-longest winning streak in 17 years.

The Nasdaq composite index surged 18.25 points or 1.20 percent to close unofficially at 1542.12, its 26th record closing high of the year. Advancing issues beat decliners 12 to nine on heavy volume of 722 million shares. The Nasdaq gained almost twice as much on a percentage basis as the Dow industrials, which saw a 0.67 percent increase.
Technology stocks have soared as investors have become less anxious about second-quarter earnings, traders said.

"The earnings are there. The numbers are starting to come in and it's almost like a panic to own them (technology stocks). The volume is just mind-boggling," said Brian Finnerty, senior vice president at Unterberg Harris.

Chip stocks lead Tuesday's advance, with the Philadelphia Stock Exchange Semiconductor Index up 3.49 percent. Intel Corp, the most active Nasdaq issue, gained 2-5/32 to 80-29/32 ahead of its second quarter earnings report. Lam Research jumped about 17 percent after its upbeat presentation at the Semicon West trade show, analysts said.
